goal: Prevent incoming Tor connections from mistakenly inheriting whitelist permissions set for local IP addresses
Require a dedicated onion bind when automatic Tor listening is active alongside custom bind parameters
agreement: Concept and approach approval without stated reasons (jeanpablojp, winterrdog)
Resolved objection: wildcard onion binds bypassed tagging and retained IP permissions, fixed by author (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents anonymous Tor peers from inheriting whitelist privileges granted to the Tor daemon IP
Eliminates misclassification of incoming onion connections forwarded to primary listening sockets
